items.title: We set maxUnavailable to zero, the platform team set a pod quota, and no release could start
items.description: Our checkout service runs twenty replicas, and its rolling update has maxUnavailable set to zero and maxSurge at twenty five percent. Zero unavailable was a rule we were proud of: a release never takes capacity away. It adds five new pods, waits for them to be ready, then removes five old ones.</
